text:
ana: FYI I started a Mistral->Llama adapter run for the new zephyr13b weights and hit a weird long-context drift during our reranker evals :confused:
ryan: drift how? regression in top-1 or general perplexity?
ana: top-1 MRR dropped ~4% after 512 tokens, short-context perf fine. streaming generation looks fine until a certain token then it starts repeating and hallucinating.
miho: sounds like KV-cache alignment problems. did you check head ordering or even/odd interleave?
ana: I dumped key tensors and noticed the key vectors suddenly have an alternating sign flip every 16 heads for the converted model vs reference. attached small diff.
sam: that points to a head-interleave vs contiguous export mismatch. some exporters lay out heads as [h0,h1,h2...] others interleave groups (h0, h8, h1, h9...). Which converter did you run?
ana: used converters/mistral_to_llama.py v2. It uses reshape((num_heads, head_dim)) then view(-1) which won't preserve interleaved layouts.
ryan: classic. reshape/view is dangerous across different memory orders. use contiguous() or explicit permutation.
ana: quick hack: permuted keys with this snippet and re-ran small inference, long-context drift disappeared: ```python
# fix snippet
W = W.reshape(n_layers, n_heads, head_dim, -1)
W = W.permute(0,2,1,3).reshape(n_layers, head_dim, n_heads* -1)
```
miho: also check rotary application: if head order is swapped but rotary expects original layout you'll get phase misapplied and decay after some positions.
sam: good point. did quantization change anything? we ran int8 dynamic on this conversion and saw earlier degradation.
ana: yeah int8 amplified it — error accumulates in kv accumulation. but warm-int8 (per-channel calib) still shows drift if head order wrong.
ryan: suggest adding two gated checks to the converter: 1) assert head-projection-reconstruction: reshape->permute->inv-reshape lands back to original within tol; 2) sample kv-cache self-consistency on a short prompt (run reference vs converted forward pass and compare cached keys at step 8).
ci-bot: run 1746667780 started: conversion-blackbox + int8-smoke + reranker-smoke (artifact link: https://ci.internal/1746667780)
miho: tokenizer gotcha: zephyr uses NFKC + custom soft hyphen handling which changed byte offsets for a few tokens; conversion script was remapping token ids by unicode ordinal which caused off-by-one in embeddings for a handful of sentinel tokens — that made debugging noisy.
ana: to isolate, I re-ran with canonicalized tokenizer and the head-order pattern still matched, so tokenizer was red herring.
sam: propose checklist for onboarding new arch combos: - export layout doc in model card - converter unit: roundtrip(reshape/permutation) assert - small-kv-smoke (8 steps) against baseline - int8 calibration run and reranker smoke - tokenizer canonicalization check
ryan: I'll open PR to update converters/README and add the unit tests. can someone add a tiny reproduction snippet to tests/fixtures so CI can catch this?
miho: adding a small fixture now. saving kernel-level note: avoid `.view()` on weight maps unless you documented memory order.
ci-bot: run 1746667780 updated 1 out of 24 tests failed (failures related to new fixture)
ana: great catch, thanks. will iterate. anyone wants to pair to add the permute-assert test?
miho: I'll take it tomorrow morning. leaving a quick comment in the PR template to run the long-context reranker suite if new reshape/permute operations are touched.
sam: also add an eval dashboard alert for >2% MRR regression after 256 tokens during onboarding.
ana: logged followups: #1 fix conversion code + permute assert; #2 add kv-smoke to CI; #3 update onboarding checklist in docs. PR link when ready. thanks all :raised_hands:
